data.description: PS5 code-review (advisory, edge-cases) on RP-05 S2a change 1925: rebar._cli._registry.route_for() resolves only canonical route names and returns None for any alias spelling. The registry validates aliases but offers no way to resolve an invocation typed as an alias to its owning Route. Out of scope for S2a (shadow-only census: the router still handles alias intercepts via _HIDDEN_ALIASES; the parity oracle only exercises canonical spellings). Belongs with the execution-dispatch cutover where route_for becomes the authoritative resolver. Acceptance: route_for(<alias>) returns the owning Route (or a documented alias->name helper), with a test for alias resolution and precedence vs canonical names; wire into dispatch at cutover (S3/S6).
data.title: route_for should resolve aliases to their owning Route
